_comment: Gain / operating-point / threshold profile for verify_cosim_pid.py. RAW gains include the sign (integer P NEGATIVE, float P POSITIVE). All values are MODEL+BUILD specific (GroupTb WAFER, VARIATION_SEED=0, sinusoid-blend build) from docs/plans/pid-cosim-verification/{PROGRESS.md,cosim-tuning-settings.md} -- they are NOT physical SQUID acceptance. Copy and adjust per fixture. Any block/key is optional; omitted values fall back to the built-in DEFAULTS in verify_cosim_pid.py, and --cli flags override this file.
